messages:
carmen: Heads-up: nightly dashboards show persistent ~2.7% deficit in trace counts during 01:00-03:00 UTC for last 7 days. Opening thread to assign owners and a backfill plan.

carmen: quick triage: raw span store has the missing spans but aggregator indices finalized the windows early. Likely late-arriving ingestion from transient producer throttling.

li: can you share a sample window id?

carmen: window: w-2026-04-02-01. Raw-store has ~1.4k spans with event_ts inside window but ingested 30-90m late.

ash: immediate mitigation we can do today: flip aggregator.grace.window from 20m->120m (feature-flagged) so finalization waits for late arrivals. Owner: ash. ETA: 2h to push and canary.

ben: longer-term: reconciliation job that diffs aggregator index vs raw-store and emits backfill tasks. I can drive the spike. Owner: ben. ETA: spike by end of week.

li: I'll add a metric compare.agg_vs_raw.delta_pct and alert on >0.5% for 30m. Owner: li. ETA: EOD.

carmen: runbook-bot: create ticket and weekly follow-ups.

runbook-bot: Created ticket INFR-4999: "Stale window finalization causing missing spans". Assigned to @ash, @ben, @li.

ash: rolling canary with grace=120m on 5% traffic now. Will monitor span-completeness and finalize-errors.

li: metric added and dashboard tile up. Alert rule configured.

ash: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% rolled over 90 minutes. No regressions; end-to-end tests passed.

ben: spike started: design doc PR https://git.internal/ops/reconcile/pulls/7 1 includes idempotent backfill tasks and rate limiting.

carmen: action recap: - ash: feature-flagged grace bump & rollout (done) - li: detector metric & alert (done) - ben: reconciliation spike + backfill job (EOW) - carmen: postmortem note and runbook edit (tomorrow noon)

ash: QA notes: forced late ingestion in staging, aggregator re-run included late spans with grace=120m. No throughput issues.

li: alert fired once before hotfix during a staging run, then was quiet after rollout.

carmen: schedule: weekly telemetry checks for 4 weeks. ben/ash to own remediation progress.

runbook-bot: Weekly reminders added to INFR-4999 for 4 weeks.

ben: will produce a small backfill run for the last 48h as part of spike; will report results here.

carmen: closing this thread for active ops. Please link any regressions to INFR-4999. :white_check_mark:
